privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: cisbox Campus works without accounts, names or a leaderboard. There is no per-person evaluation and no tracking.
privacy.p2: What lives in your browser: your last 20 attempts (points, percentage, duration, time), your chosen language and appearance. This data never leaves your device.
privacy.p3: A test in progress is cached only for the duration of the browser session and deleted after submission.
privacy.p4: The app is delivered via GitHub Pages. For technical reasons the hosting provider keeps access logs (IP address, time, requested file). cisbox has no access to them.
privacy.p5: No cookies, no analytics, no third-party scripts or fonts.
